Some suggestions for obtaining the other required materials:
• Soda ash can be pickpocketed from Ithell workers if you do not wish to burn seaweed yourself. They are also dropped in bulk from corrupted workers.

• Gold stone spirits are reasonably common from a wide variety of monsters. Gemstone dragons are a good source and also good Slayer experience. Gold stone spirits are also a reward from Shooting Stars and can be traded in with stardust.
• Luminite stone spirits are only dropped by a few monsters, primarily TzekHaar, gargoyles, and spiritual warriors. One option is killing bound skeletons, which are fairly easy, aggressive monsters.…

The following table shows the required materials to make a glorious bar starting from ores.
▸ Creation process
This method involves creating glorious bars from scratch, which can be done at any furnace and anvil.
• At any furnace, smelt 50 concentrated alloy bars using 1 of each of the bars listed above per alloy bar. 
• At any furnace, use the concentrated alloy bars to smelt 10 enriched alloy bars
• At any furnace, use the enriched alloy bars to smelt 1 immaculate alloy bar
• At any anvil, start folding the immaculate alloy bar into a partially folded alloy bar (in the smithing interface, it is located under Glorious bar)
• A partially folded alloy bar must be folded 1,001 times to produce a glorious bar. It takes about 2,004 ticks, or 20 minutes, to produce one glorious bar.
